**Finding submitted: MISSING (critical) — no Vendor indemnity in the Agreement.**

What I found:
- Section 7 is captioned "LIMITATIONS OF LIABILITY; **INDEMNIFICATION OF CONTRACTOR**," but its three subsections contain only liability caps, a consequential-damages waiver, and an attorneys'-fees waiver. A full-document search for "indemn" and "hold harmless" returned only the heading — there is no operative indemnity anywhere.
- This leaves Contractor's Section 5(c) IP non-infringement warranty with no defence obligation behind it, while Contractor's liability is capped at fees paid and each party waives attorneys' fees.
- No Clear Capital-side indemnity exists, so no narrowing of a Customer indemnity was needed.

Redline (validated, ok:true): new **Section 7(d)** inserted after p0037 requiring Contractor to defend, indemnify and hold harmless Clear Capital and its affiliates for third-party claims arising from (i) IP infringement/misappropriation by the Services or Works, (ii) Contractor's breach of applicable law, (iii) Contractor-caused unauthorised access to our Confidential Information, and (iv) Contractor's gross negligence or wilful misconduct — with standard notice/control/cooperation mechanics, a consent right on settlements binding us, and an express carve-out from the Section 7(a)-(c) limitations so the indemnity is not swallowed by the fee cap.

Fallback flagged in the comment for negotiation: customary IP exclusions (our modifications, combinations, specifications) and a 3× annual fees super-cap on the indemnity.
